name: Denied

gist.Natas, the Master of Hell: May skip his draw to take a fresh copy of The Master's Plan instead, every turn.
gist.The Master's Plan: Reaction: cancels any one card you play from hand, once per turn.
gist.Rusty Touch: Cancels an artifact; you still pay for it.
gist.Storm Ring: Cancels a spell that would hit more than one target.
gist.Shamanic Curse: Raises the level of a spell you cast, often out of reach.
gist.Off Duty: Cancels a summoned creature and shuffles it away.
gist.Silence: Once: cancels a spell and stops you casting more that turn.
gist.Anti Magic Shield: Cancels a cheap spell that hits its hero.
gist.Fiedel, the Mercenary Mage: Sturdy; uses reaction spells a level cheaper.
gist.Mr. Jiggles: His damage: hits two targets a turn.
gist.Haressassin: A hard single shot each turn.

plan: Sammy says no. Natas produces a Master's Plan every turn, and around it sits a reaction for every kind of card: artifacts, sweepers, hero effects, cheap spells, big spells. He taps nothing on his own turn except to add one shooter. The damage is three kinds of small creature and takes for ever. He can only cancel what is played from hand, one or two things a turn, and nothing he has answers damage that is already on the table.

looks.early: Three heroes, no board, a full hand held very still.
looks.mid: One or two shooters and a hand of seven; every card you play gets a card in reply.
looks.late: A discard pile full of your negated Spells and three small creatures finishing the job.

opening.tell: He passes his turns with a full hand and no board.
opening.why: Nothing he holds stops Ability attachments, and an attached Gathering Storm ticks without being played again; he has no pressure early, so levels are free, while sweepers have nothing to hit.

midgame.tell: He keeps one card apart and has two shooters out.
midgame.why: Two real plays a turn, lesser one first: he cancels one. The key spell cast first is the one that gets cancelled.

crisis.tell: His hand is seven reactions; Natas takes another Plan instead of drawing.
crisis.why: The White Eye discards from that hand blind, and a frozen or dead Natas ends the supply; racing just feeds every spell into a cancel.

endgame.tell: His hand is down to two cards and the Storm is ticking.
endgame.why: He cannot cancel ticks, and his heroes have no other defence.

opening.board: Sammy passes with seven cards and nothing on the table.

options.text: Attach Destruction Magic; it cannot be cancelled
Chain Lightning into a waiting Plan
Hold a sweeper for no one

opening.board: A Haressassin appears; he still holds six cards.

options.text: Lesser spell as bait, then attach the Storm
White Eye... once it is equipped

opening.board: Tool Freezer cancels your Magnetic Glove.

midgame.board: One card held apart; two shooters firing.

options.text: Bait with Tea, then Flame Avalanche

midgame.board: Shamanic Curse pushes your spell out of reach.

options.text: Follow with an artifact he must also answer

crisis.board: Natas takes a Plan instead of a card again.
Divine Punishment cancels Nicolas's potion draw.

options.text: Freeze Natas with a second Snow Cannon

endgame.board: Two cards left in his hand.

options.text: Three plays this turn: one lands

endgame.board: Fiedel alone, sturdy, with a Spike Trap.
